title: Sidley Austin Professor of Law
bio: Jacob Gersen is Sidley Austin Professor of Law at Harvard Law School, Affiliate Professor in the Department of Government, and Director of the Food Law Lab, which supports academic research on the legal treatment of food in society. He is also the co-editor of Food Law & Policy. Before joining the Harvard faculty in 2011, he […]
